page.about.info.intro.title: Introduction
page.about.info.intro.text: I am a software engineer with over 9 years in web development. While I have worked across the full stack — from backend APIs to mobile apps — my focus is front-end engineering. For me, interfaces are not about animation overload, but about clarity, architecture, and usability. Today, my main priority is building blockchain-driven applications and exploring the intersection of web and AI.
page.about.info.pseudonym.title: Brand
page.about.info.pseudonym.text: Amary Filo is my personal pseudonym and brand. It doesn’t have a strict definition — it’s a creative identity I shaped around simplicity and recognition. The llama 🦙 became my symbol: independent, adaptive, and a little unconventional — just like my approach to development.
page.about.info.tagline.title: Principles
page.about.info.tagline.text: 'Every problem has a solution. Development is about patience, clarity, and the courage to explore new technologies.' - amaryfilo
page.about.info.hobbies.title: Beyond Code
page.about.info.hobbies.text: Beyond programming, I explore UI/UX design, maintain a personal blog, and share my knowledge with developers through social media and educational content. I enjoy experimenting with new technologies, creating resources for others, and documenting my journey in web and blockchain development. This helps me not only grow as a professional but also contribute to the community.
